goals: Collect behavior-neutral evidence showing where minecraft:entity.item.pickup stops during one ordinary real-world item pickup on Minecraft Java 26.2 Fabric.
scope: Client-only observation of the exact 26.2 ClientPacketListener take-item handler, ClientLevel local-sound API, SoundManager play facade, and SoundEngine play path for minecraft:entity.item.pickup only.

Correlate a normal take-item packet through synchronous local sound processing when that association is exact, then log SoundEngine entry, first vanilla instruction, post-resolution sample fields, and natural PlayResult return.

exclusions: No CCAR source, artifact, routed-pickup marker, packet, inventory, item entity, particle, animation, statistic, routing, resource-pack, Minecraft setting, or unrelated project change.
No sound replay, suppression, cancellation, delay, argument modification, volume/pitch adjustment, configuration, persistent save data, or non-pickup per-sound logging.
No Test Instance Manager transition, Minecraft launch, dedicated Workbench mutation, or protected Matcha Flavoured 26.1.2 gameplay-profile access is implied by this static release.

dependencies.reason: Exact mapped target for the observed client packet and sound-method signatures.
